signal_sources: Supabase Auth logs: rolling 24h aggregate counts, captcha_failed, signup/OTP failures, observed 429 and 5xx
Read-only STAGING user/device/session and learning-event count cross-check; exclude credentials and learner records
GitHub Issue #12 monitoring tracker and sanitized incident Issues

P0.response: STOP STAGING security tests, preserve sanitized aggregates, escalate to Primary and Backup; no destructive change

P1.response: Freeze affected test path; read-only inspect; owner and reviewer approve containment

P2.response: Compare Auth aggregate baseline and investigate; no unbounded load/retries

response_time_origin: From actual human detection or confirmed alert receipt DURING AGREED COVERAGE, not onset of an undetected event
missed_review_rule: At 09:15 if Primary has not posted a sanitized daily review, Backup follows up; at 09:30 log a missed review and pause any high-risk STAGING security test pending human approval. No automatic follow-up is enabled.

short_form_cadence_intent.interpretation: Both users posted the role-specific APPROVE CADENCE keyword in the thread containing the detailed 09:00 proposal; this establishes agreement-in-principle, not independently confirmed coverage/SLA terms.
